scope: Every media URL present in the repository — curated YouTube videos, NASA Images/Video Library API records, corpus-embedded links, knowledge-base SVS references — live-verified where this environment's network permits.
dedupe: Same media id under multiple origins merges into one canonical entry; duplicate occurrences recorded below. Separate media items are never merged.

entries.title: Why Fires In Space Are So Dangerous
entries.author: Scott Manley
entries.overview: Accessible explanation of why flames behave differently in microgravity — spherical diffusion flames, no buoyant plume — the exact physics regime of the PSI corpus. Good orientation for non-specialists.

verify.title: Why Fires In Space Are So Dangerous
verify.author: Scott Manley

entries.title: Understanding Cool Flames and Warm Flames — Yiguang Ju
entries.author: The Combustion Institute
entries.overview: Combustion Institute lecture on cool-flame chemistry and limits — directly the science of CFI (droplet cool flames) and CFI-G (gaseous cool flames, up to 85% O₂ at the burner), including two-stage ignition and extinction physics.

verify.title: Understanding Cool Flames and Warm Flames, Yiguang Ju

entries.title: High Pressure Combustion in Microgravity using Biofuel — Ziaul Rizal
entries.author: AITC Mission Integration (Land Grant Seminar Series)
entries.overview: Research seminar on droplet-scale microgravity combustion at elevated pressure — methodologically adjacent to FLEX/FLEX-2 droplet extinction studies (pressure and diluent sweeps on isolated droplets).

entries.title: Master Class: Flame Fundamentals
entries.author: KAUST Clean Energy Research
entries.overview: Flame fundamentals — stoichiometry, flame structure, soot and luminosity — the theoretical background behind the SPICE smoke-point investigation and the equation registry's combustion section.

entries.title: Combustion Physics, Law, Day 1, Part 1
entries.author: Princeton University Combustion Summer School
entries.overview: Prof. Chung Law's combustion physics lectures — the same framework (droplet burning, flammability limits, extinction) that underlies the FLEX-family analyses and the project's verified equation sources.

entries.title: Webinar #6 Physical Science: Fluid Dynamics (AccSpace4All Hypergravity/Microgravity Series)
entries.author: UN Office for Outer Space Affairs
entries.overview: UNOOSA webinar on microgravity physical-science research — programme context for why fluids/combustion experiments run on orbiting laboratories and how the results transfer (or do not) to partial gravity.
